bead.title: harness/codex: record model_surface cassette (no-static-fallback prerequisite)
bead.description: Record an authenticated TUI cassette at internal/harnesses/codex/testdata/model_surface/ by running ReadCodexModelDiscoveryViaPTY against a current codex CLI. Resulting cassette must include gpt-5.4-nano (or whatever the live TUI exposes) and the current reasoning levels.
bead.acceptance:
1) internal/harnesses/codex/testdata/model_surface/ exists with cassette manifest + frames.jsonl + service-events.jsonl per ADR-002 schema v1.
2) ReadCodexModelDiscoveryFromCassette("internal/harnesses/codex/testdata/model_surface") returns a non-empty snapshot whose Models slice contains the current live set including gpt-5.4-nano if the live CLI exposes it.
3) A focused unit test asserts the cassette parses and yields non-empty Models.
4) go test ./internal/harnesses/codex/... -count=1 green.
